==Description==
This template is used for creating the blue "archive box" on pages that other [[:Category:Archive templates|archive templates]] don't cover. Examples include [[:Category:Retired site features|retired site features]].

==Usage==
Place the following code at the top of the page to be archived:
<pre>
{{subst:Archive}}
</pre>

Then, to avoid disrupting the page layout, add this closing tag at the very end of the thread:
<pre>
</div>
</pre>
